title: One Live Northbeam Circle Membership to a Customer Profile
content:
## One live membership to a profile

1. A customer profile carries at most one Northbeam Circle Membership at a time, whatever the tier. The
   most a profile may hold is 1 live membership.
2. Enrolment is refused when the profile already holds a membership whose standing is an application
   received, active or grace, and the customer is moved between tiers instead of being enrolled a second
   time.
3. A membership whose standing is lapsed or cancelled does not block a fresh enrolment: the earlier
   record stays on file for history and a new membership record is opened alongside it.
4. Household seats and business seats attached to a membership are shared use of one membership and are
   never counted as memberships of their own.

## What the desk reads before an enrolment is taken

The test is made on the membership records held against the profile before the enrolment is taken, read
by the customer the membership belongs to, and on the standing and tier recorded there. The system record
is the authority for it; a caller's account of which memberships they hold does not displace the record.
Where a live membership is found, the existing record is the one the customer keeps.

## Cases on the dedup test

| Standing found on the profile | Fresh enrolment |
|---|---|
| An application received | Refused; the customer is moved between tiers on the existing record |
| Active | Refused; the customer is moved between tiers on the existing record |
| Grace | Refused; the customer is moved between tiers on the existing record |
| Lapsed | Taken; the lapsed record stays on file and a new record is opened |
| Cancelled | Taken; the cancelled record stays on file and a new record is opened |
| No membership at all | Taken |

A profile holding one active Circle membership with 4 household seats in use still holds one membership
for this purpose, so a second enrolment on that profile is refused. Two membership records may therefore
stand against one profile only where the earlier of them is lapsed or cancelled.
